title: Map five-source connector prices and boundary contracts
head: 9f668f5860b229d931d5250418c4893004c7577d
body:
The contribution guide points new connector work at the original five-source boundary, while the repository now retains the complete 36-positive-price optimum. Add a bounded scope map linking that completed question to the older 74-call and fixed-price 182 results, with a guide entry point before repricing the original alphabet.

The map distinguishes six reviewed contracts: offline unit calls, one fixed leaf-price vector, all positive tariffs, sequential output delivery, paid connector frames and combined pair-source calls. It preserves the maintainer's narrow #2056 statement (72-query construction and universal paired-readout path minimum, not a general optimum over the expanded alphabet), and separates #1945's A/B-call floor from a full tariff claim. Existing source packages, selected frontier, task weights and dispositions remain unchanged.

Evidence: six exact README SHA-256/Git-blob bindings, six reviewed ledger heads/dispositions and unchanged live heads checked at 2026-10-15 17:39:44 UTC. Fourteen local links pass. The retained #2063 verifier passed on CPython 3.12.7: 945 pairings, 16 profiles, 3,552 dirty-basis case pairs and nine controls. A separate agent reviewed the prose, source hashes and scope distinctions with no blocker; it did not rerun mathematical suites. No new mathematical result, full supplier replay or human review is claimed.

Selected from current main `b5ea56e0a5ac4552166253b1fa4be0753bb38c30`, priority revision 5, consolidation seed `bd70a57e73291f884e50c43345c91610`; the baseline binding check passed. Main was fetched again before submission and unchanged. Overlap screening used 786 open PRs refreshed at 17:35:58 UTC, 1,621 closed PRs cached at 17:22:49 UTC and 1,303 Discussion records cached at 16:54:03 UTC. The Discussion refresh hit the GraphQL rate limit, explicitly recorded in the source receipt; this is not complete diff or unpublished-work coverage. This is one navigation repair, with predecessor results and credit retained.

Prepared by ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.
